Protein-Forward

Golden Tofu & Edamame Bowls

A simple, satisfying bowl focusing on flavor and texture. The tofu gets a quick pan-fry until golden, served over rice and edamame with a rich peanut sauce.

Estimated total
25 min (using pre-cooked rice)
Method
Skillet
Ingredients & Method ↓

Development edition · Awaits kitchen testing.

Ingredients Method Storage

Ingredients

How many people?
2

FOR A LARGER BATCH

If scaling up, brown the tofu in batches so the skillet doesn't get crowded. The sauce water should still be adjusted gradually.

Estimated to serve 2 people as a main meal.

  • 300 g firm tofu, drained
  • 150 g shelled edamame
  • 250 g cooked rice
  • 2 tsp neutral oil
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1.5 tbsp unsweetened peanut butter
    Missing this?

    Use tahini · 1.5 tbsp

    The flavor profile changes to sesame. Adjust the water gradually as needed. (Contains sesame).

  • 1 tbsp lemon juice
  • Water, as needed
  • Sliced scallions, to serve (optional)

Contains soy and peanuts. May contain wheat (check soy sauce).

Method

You'll need
Skillet · Small mixing bowl

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

This recipe requires pre-cooked rice that has been properly cooled and stored. The estimated 25 minutes does not include the time to cook the rice. Food safety guide

Prep

01

Prepare the tofu

Gently pat the firm tofu, drained dry with a clean kitchen towel or paper towel, then cut it into bite-sized cubes.

Cook

02

Pan-fry the tofu

Heat the neutral oil in a skillet over medium heat. Arrange the tofu cubes in a single layer. Let them cook undisturbed until the bottom is golden brown, then flip to brown the other sides. Perfect uniform crispness isn't required.

Look for: Golden brown surfaces on the tofu cubes.

03

Prepare edamame and rice

Cook or thaw the shelled edamame according to the package instructions. Safely reheat the cooked rice until steaming hot throughout.

Finish

04

Make the sauce

In a small bowl, whisk together the unsweetened peanut butter, soy sauce, and lemon juice. Add Water, as needed a little at a time until the sauce is creamy and fluid enough to drizzle easily.

05

Assemble the bowls

Divide the rice, edamame, and golden tofu between serving bowls. Drizzle with the sauce and top with Sliced scallions, to serve (optional) if using.

IF YOURS LOOKS...

If the sauce is too thick, simply whisk in a splash more water until you reach the desired consistency.

Serve with

Serve warm in bowls.

Storage & Prep ahead

If storing leftovers, keep the sauce separate. This recipe relies on pre-cooked rice. Ensure the rice was cooled quickly and stored correctly before using.

Store leftovers in the fridge for up to 2 days.
